blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Weakly-supervised Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) models assign anomaly scores from high-dimensional features, and their predictions remain unexplained. Saliency maps show where a model looks but not what it relies on, and the descriptions produced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are generated by branches that the anomaly score never reads. To address this faithfulness gap, we propose \textbf{Explain The Unexplainable (ETU)}, a classifier-agnostic framework that audits frozen VAD models through counterfactual interventions in their feature space. ETU maps video features to a discrete dependency graph of agents, actions and outcomes ($A_r \to A_a \to A_o$), regenerates the features by graph-conditioned diffusion with selected nodes of the graph masked, and measures the change in the score of a frozen detector; one set of interventions is applied unchanged to every detector. The generator is trained only to reconstruct the input features, so it cannot learn the contrast it is asked to measure, and we validate the audit with experiments that test every alternative explanation of its results, from the cost of regeneration to random deletions of matched size. On UCF-Crime features obtained from a CLIP encoder, we show that substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and that removing the outcome chain of the graph ($Δ_{rel}$) changes the anomaly score of all six audited detectors far more than removing the same number of random nodes, even though the random deletion perturbs the features about as much. We show that this targeted behavior comes from the divergence objective of the graph embedding. Without it, the two interventions become indistinguishable, and with a divergence objective in the generator as well, the score change of the detector follows the displacement of the reconstruction rather than the semantics that were removed.
blocks.zh: 监督不力 Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) 模型从高维特性分配出异常分数,它们的预测仍然无法解释. 显要地图显示一个模型的外观而非所依赖的,由Vision-Language Models(VLMs)制作的描述由异常分数从未读取的分支生成. 为了弥补这种忠诚差距,我们提议\textbf{解释无法解释的(ETU)},这是一个分类-不可知框架,通过在功能空间的反事实干预来审计冻结的VAD模型。 ETU将视频特性映射到一个离散的依赖图上,其中包含物剂,动作和结果($A_r\r到A_a\to A_o$),以图被遮住的选定节点来再生这些特性,并测量被冷冻的探测器的分数变化;一组干预措施对每一个探测器都适用不变. 生成器只接受过重建输入特性的培训,因此它无法了解它被要求测量的对比度,我们通过实验来验证审计结果的每一个替代解释,从再生成本到大小相匹配的随机删除. 关于从一个CLIP编码器获得的UCF-Crime特性,我们显示,替代场景语义对大多数探测器来说是最大的下降,并且去除图中的结果链($Δ_{rel}$)会改变所有六个被审计的探测器的异常分数远不止于去除同样数目的随机节点,尽管随机删除会干扰同样多的特性. 我们显示,这种有针对性的行为来自于图嵌入的分化目标. 没有它,这两种干预就变得不可区分,而且随着发生器的分数也存在分歧,探测器的分数变化会随着重建的转移而不是被移除的语义而发生.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) detects events that are unusual within a video’s context; because anomalies are sparse and unpredictable, its public datasets are mostly real-world CCTV footage of crimes and accidents. The dominant paradigm, Weakly-Supervised VAD (WSVAD), tackles this task relying solely on video-level labels. This paradigm is based on Multiple Instance Learning (MIL), pushing a WSVAD model to assign high anomaly scores to the most abnormal snippets of a known anomalous video and low scores for snippets of known normal videos. However, a critical drawback of MIL-based models is the inherently unexplainable nature of their predictions, which rely on high-dimensional feature spaces that are prone to spurious correlations.
blocks.zh: Video Anomaly Detection(VAD)侦测到视频背景中不寻常的事件; 由于异常现象稀少且不可预测, 占主导地位的范式,弱监督VAD(WSVAD),完全依靠视频级别的标签来处理这项任务. 这个范式基于多例学习(MIL),推动一个WSVAD模型,为已知异常视频的最异常片段分配高异常分数,为已知正常视频片段分配低分数. 然而,基于MIL的模型的一个重要缺点是其预测的内在无法解释的性质,这些预测依赖于容易产生虚假关联的高维特征空间.

blocks.en: Explainable VAD aims to untangle such correlations. Common approaches produce saliency maps over the pixels that most influence the score [ 54 , 10 ] , answering “ where is the model looking? ”. But VAD models rarely process raw pixels; they consume high-dimensional, pre-trained encoders such as I3D [ 4 ] or CLIP [ 36 ] . In this latent context, post-hoc attribution techniques such as Grad-CAM [ 41 ] are fundamentally limited, as they capture spatial correlation rather than the score’s dependence on content. Liu and Ma [ 26 ] showed that VAD models exploit the scene background as a cue for the anomaly rather than the event itself, which suggests that they rely on spurious correlations in the feature space rather than on the actual events.
blocks.zh: 可解释的VAD旨在解开这种关联. 通用方法在像素上绘制出最能影响分数的显著地图[54, 10],回答“模型在哪里看?” 但VAD模型很少会处理原始像素;它们会消耗高维,预先训练的编码器,如I3D[4]或CLIP[36]. 在这种潜在背景下,Grad-CAM[41]等后期归属技术根本上是有限的,因为它们捕捉空间相关性而不是得分对内容的依赖。 刘和马[26]显示,VAD模型利用场景背景作为异常点而不是事件本身的提示,这表明它们依赖于特征空间中的虚假关联,而不是实际事件.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : A VLM explainer’s caption changes under a counterfactual prompt but its score does not. Counterfactual prompting of Holmes-VAU [ 67 ] on the “robbery” video provided in the official repository. The anomaly scores obtained with the two prompts are nearly identical, so the score does not follow the explanation the model gives, while the counterfactual explanation mentions the very person the prompt instructed to ignore.
blocks.zh: 图1:在反事实提示下, VLM 解释器的字幕会改变, 但其分数不会改变 。 在官方寄存器提供的“抢劫”视频上, 与两个提示获得的异常分数几乎相同,因此该分数没有遵循模型给出的解释,而反事实解释则提到了指示忽略的提示人本身.

blocks.en: Recently, the field has pivoted toward Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to provide descriptive grounding for anomaly detections [ 65 , 67 ] . While these methods address the "what" of a scene, they typically employ parallel architectural branches that generate captions and anomaly scores through functionally decoupled pathways. This structural separation introduces a faithfulness gap. The generated caption serves as a post-hoc rationalization rather than an input the model’s decision depends on, as shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 最近,实地向Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)倾斜,为异常探测提供描述性的基础[65、67]。 虽然这些方法处理一个场景的"什么",但是它们通常使用平行的建筑分支,通过功能脱节的路径生成字幕和异常分数. 这种结构上的分离带来了忠诚的鸿沟. 如图1所示,生成的字幕是一种事后的合理化,而不是模型决定所依赖的投入。

blocks.en: To bridge this faithfulness gap, we propose Explain The Unexplainable (ETU, Figure 2 ), a classifier-agnostic framework designed to audit frozen VAD models by intervening directly in their latent feature space. ETU enforces a strict semantic bottleneck by mapping continuous video features into a discrete semantic manifold structured as a hierarchical dependency graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} representing compositional semantics, namely the agents involved (Roots, A r A_{r} ), their specific behaviors (Actions, A a A_{a} ), and the resulting consequences (Outcomes, A o A_{o} ). To establish a structural prior for this space, we utilize an offline VLM that observes each video and emits valid A r → A a → A o A_{r}\to A_{a}\to A_{o} chains directly. ETU then regenerates the features by graph-conditioned diffusion under a masked graph (e.g., with an anomaly-relevant sequence removed). The frozen model’s response to these reconstructions moves the question from the spatial correlations of saliency maps (“ where is the model looking? ”) and the decoupled descriptions of VLMs (“ what is happening? ”) to intervention-based auditing (“ how much did this score depend on the semantics the graph names? ”).
blocks.zh: 为了弥合这种忠实差距,我们提议解释无法解释的(ETU,图2),这是一个分类-不可知框架,旨在通过直接干预冻结的VAD模型的潜在特征空间来审计这些模型。 ETU执行严格的语义瓶颈,将连续的视频特征映射成一个分级依赖图G\mathcal{G}结构的离散语义多面体,代表构成语义,即所涉物剂(Roots, A r A_{r}),他们的具体行为(Actions, A_{a}),以及由此产生的后果(Ecomes, Ao_{o}). 为了建立这个空间的前置结构, 我们使用离线的 VLM , ETU随后通过一个蒙面图下的图条件扩散(例如,取消了一个异常相关序列)来再生特征. 被冻结的模型对这些重建的反应将问题从显著地图的空间相关性(“模型在哪里看?”)和VLM的描述(“正在发生什么? ”)转移到干预审计(“这个分数有多少取决于图名的语义?” ) 。

blocks.en: ETU is a two-stage pipeline. In the first stage, the Graph Embedding Model (GEM) maps video features into a discrete atom space and infers the directed dependency edges between roots, actions, and outcomes. The topology is aggregated into a compact latent embedding ( 𝐳 graph \mathbf{z}_{\text{graph}} ), distilling the offline VLM’s structural priors into a lightweight model with no test-time text generation. In the second stage, a Graph-conditioned Feature Diffusion (GFD) model performs guided denoising of noisy ground-truth features conditioned on this embedding. It is trained only to reconstruct the encoder features under the complete graph. During inference, we condition the diffusion process on three deterministic masked variants of the graph, which remove the core anomaly chains ( 𝐳 rel \mathbf{z}_{\text{rel}} ), prune irrelevant background events ( 𝐳 irr \mathbf{z}_{\text{irr}} ), or replace the scene semantics ( 𝐳 sem \mathbf{z}_{\text{sem}} ). The downstream VAD model’s response to these reconstructions is an anomaly delta ( Δ \Delta ) [ 56 ] that measures how much the prediction depended on the masked part of the conditioning graph.
blocks.zh: ETU是两阶段的管道. 在第一阶段,图嵌入模型(GEM)将视频特征映射到一个离散的原子空间,并推断出根、动作和结果之间的直接依赖边缘。 地形被聚合成一个紧凑的潜伏嵌入( z graph \ mathbf{z}_{\text{graph} ) , 将离线的 VLM 结构前缀蒸馏成一个没有测试时间文本生成的轻量级模型 。 在第二阶段,以这种嵌入为条件的图状特征扩散模型对噪音的地面真象特征进行引导解码。 它只被训练为在完整图下重建编码器特征. 在推论中,我们将扩散过程以图的3个定型蒙面变体作为条件,这些变体去除核心异常链(z rel\mathbf{z}_{\text{rel}}),prune无关的背景事件(z irr\mathbf{z}_{\text{irr}}),或者替换场景语义(z sem\mathb{z}_{\text{sem}}). 下游的VAD模型对这些重建的反应是一个反常的三角洲(QQ\Delta)[56],该三角洲测量了预测在多大程度上依赖于调节图的遮盖部分.

blocks.en: An audit of this kind has a failure mode of its own, and we treat it as part of the method. A generator trained to make the relevant-mask reconstructions diverge can manufacture the very contrast it is asked to measure, and a frozen detector scored on regenerated features may react to the distribution shift rather than to the content [ 16 , 39 ] . ETU therefore keeps its generator out of that objective, training it on reconstruction alone, and every quantity we report is compared with a lower bound or with a test that can fail (Section 4.2 ), including a generator that does carry a divergence objective and whose deltas follow the displacement of the reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 这种审计有自己的失败模式,我们把它当作方法的一部分。 训练有素的发电机可以制造出它被要求测量的对比,在再生成的特性上得分的冷冻探测器可能会对分配变化作出反应,而不是对内容作出反应[16,39]。 因此,ETU将发电机排除在这一目标之外,仅对它进行重建培训,我们报告的每个数量都比作较低的限值或可能失败的测试(第4.2节),包括一个确实具有分歧目标的发电机,其三角洲跟踪重建的转移。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are: • A framework. ETU, a classifier-agnostic framework for the counterfactual auditing of frozen VAD models. A graph embedding model maps the video features to a discrete A r → A a → A o A_{r}\to A_{a}\to A_{o} dependency graph, and a graph-conditioned diffusion model, trained only to reconstruct the features, regenerates them under masked graphs, so that one set of interventions is handed unchanged to every detector and read as a change of its score. • Validation. The lower bounds, count-matched random deletions and their displacement, ablations of the divergence objective in the graph embedding and in the generator, and a comparison of the graphs of three teachers that a feature-space counterfactual audit needs before its numbers can be attributed to the detector, each stated with the alternative explanation it rules out and with its outcome. • A targeted intervention. Substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and removing the outcome chain costs all six detectors more than removing the same number of random nodes, although the random deletion displaces the reconstructed features about as much. We show that the divergence objective of the graph embedding is the design choice that makes this possible. Without it the two deletions become indistinguishable, and a divergence objective in the generator makes the deltas follow the displacement instead. The delta is therefore read as the dependence of the score on graph-conditioned content, and not as the removal of a concept.
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献是: ETU,一个对冻结VAD模型进行反事实审计的分类-不可知性框架. 一个嵌入模型的图表将视频特性映射到一个离散的 A r → A a → A o A _{r}\to A_{a}\to A_{o}]依赖图,以及一个以图为条件的传播模型,只经过重建特征的训练,在蒙面图下再生它们,这样一集的干预会被不变地交给每个探测器,并读作它的分数的变化. • 鉴定。 下限,计数的随机删除及其移位,在图嵌入和生成器中盘点差异目标,以及比较三位老师的图表,一个特征-空间反事实审计需要后,才能将数字归结于探测器,每个都用它排除的替代解释和结果表示. • 有针对性的干预。 替换场景语义导致大多数探测器降幅最大,并且移除结果链比去除相同数量的随机节点还要花费所有6个探测器,尽管随机删除将重建的特征相去甚远. 我们显示,图嵌入式的歧义是设计选择,使这一点成为可能。 没有它,两个删除变得不可区分,而生成器中存在分歧的目标使得三角洲紧随迁移。 因此,三角洲被理解为比分对图条件内容的依赖,而不是去除一个概念.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 弱监督视频异常检测

blocks.en: The dominant paradigm in Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is Weakly-Supervised learning (WSVAD), which utilizes only video-level labels for training [ 45 , 71 , 57 , 68 , 73 , 35 , 52 , 56 ] . Sultani et al. [ 45 ] established the foundation, using MIL to identify the most salient anomalous segments within video “bags.” Subsequent work refines the discriminative power of that objective with feature magnitude and discriminability [ 49 , 6 ] , unbiased classifiers against label noise [ 29 ] , self-training and mixture-of-experts designs [ 25 , 7 , 8 ] , and multimodal features [ 30 , 65 ] . WSVAD models nevertheless map high-dimensional features directly to scalar scores. They localize in time but offer no semantic justification for a prediction.
blocks.zh: 视频异常检测(VAD)中的主要范例是弱监督学习(WSVAD),培训时只使用视频级别的标签[45,71,57,68,73,35,52,56]. 苏尔塔尼等人. [45] 建立了该基金会,利用MIL来确定视频“包”中最突出的异常部分。 随后的工作使这一目标的歧视性力量更加精炼,具有特征规模和歧视性[49、6],对标签噪声进行无偏见的分类[29],自我培训和专家混合设计[25、7、8],以及多式联运特征[30、65]。 尽管如此,WSVAD模型还是将高维特性直接映射到标分. 它们及时定位,但没有为预测提供语义上的理由。

blocks.en: 2.2 Explainable Video Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 可解释视频异常检测

blocks.en: Explainable VAD has focused on spatial localization (“ where ”) and semantic description (“ what ”). Traditional frameworks interpret via pixel-level reconstruction errors or gradient-based saliency [ 47 ] , which capture spatial correlation rather than the score’s dependence on semantic content. To inject semantics, attribute-based methods evaluate normality against pre-defined taxonomies of trajectories [ 43 ] , poses [ 38 ] , or interactions [ 46 , 15 ] , whose dataset-specific ontologies struggle to generalize to novel anomaly classes. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) instead generate rich, textual explanations [ 28 , 61 , 60 , 64 , 67 ] , but usually exhibit the faithfulness gap of Figure 1 . Captions and anomaly scores come from parallel, functionally decoupled branches, so the outputs are post-hoc rationalizations that describe the scene rather than audit the detector’s internal logic. VERA [ 61 ] is an exception, feeding the questions it learns into the score it reports.
blocks.zh: 可解释的VAD侧重于空间定位(“在哪里”)和语义描述(“什么”)。 传统框架通过像素级重建错误或基于梯度的显著性来解释[47],它捕捉空间相关性而不是得分对语义内容的依赖. 为了注入语义学,基于属性的方法对照预定义的轨迹分类学[43]来评价常态性,构成[38],或相互作用[46,15],其数据集特有的本体学难以概括为新奇异常类. Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)转而产生丰富的文字解释[28,61,60,64,67],但通常表现出图1的忠实差距. 说明和异常分数来自平行的,功能上脱节的分支,因此产出是描述场景而不是审计探测器的内部逻辑的热度后合理化. VERA[61]是一个例外,将它学到的问题输入它报告的得分.

blocks.en: 2.3 Faithfulness and Concept Interventions
blocks.zh: 2.3 忠诚和概念干预

blocks.en: Deletion-based faithfulness tests score a model on inputs from which the attributed content has been removed. ROAR [ 16 ] showed that the resulting drop conflates importance with distribution shift, and retrains the model to separate the two. ROAD [ 39 ] showed that the shape of the deletion mask leaks class information, and replaced retraining with imputation. F-Fidelity [ 70 ] and GOAR [ 31 ] harden the evaluation against the out-of-distribution inputs that deletion creates. ETU regenerates the input instead of retraining the model (Eq. 8 ), and its count-matched random deletion plays the role of the leakage check of ROAD.
blocks.zh: 基于删除的忠诚度测试在输入值上得分,所归属的内容已被删除. 注重成果的年度报告[16]表明,结果的下降将重要性与分配的转变混为一谈,并重述将两者分开的模式。 ROAD [39] 显示删除口罩的形状会泄露班级信息,并用估算法取代再培训. F-Fidelity [70] 和 GOAR [31] 对删除产生的分配外输入进行更严格的评价. ETU重新生成输入而不是再培训模型(Eq.8),其计数的随机删除起到ROAD的渗漏检查的作用.

blocks.en: Concept-level methods such as TCAV [ 21 ] , ACE [ 12 ] and CRAFT [ 11 ] , concept bottlenecks with their post-hoc, counterfactual and intervenable variants [ 22 , 63 , 9 , 24 ] , and linear concept erasure [ 3 ] intervene on concepts inside the representation of the model itself, and their conclusions depend on the probe set [ 37 ] . The quantity we estimate is the causal concept effect of Goyal et al. [ 13 ] , which ETU obtains from a regeneration instead of a generative in-fill such as FIDO [ 5 ] , whose off-distribution hazard Hase et al. [ 14 ] document. Diffusion counterfactuals edit images or videos for a given classifier [ 18 , 19 , 55 , 51 , 53 ] , and counterfactual generation has been used to explain image anomaly detectors [ 20 , 27 ] . Prior concept-intervention methods intervene inside the model being explained, so the intervention and the explanation share parameters. ETU instead intervenes on the input of a model it never trains against, which is what makes one set of interventions comparable across independently trained detectors. Its generator is trained to reconstruct the input and never to separate the interventions, and the objective that shapes its conditioning is a design choice that we verify in Section 4 .

blocks.en:
ETU turns “which semantics does this score depend on?” into an intervention experiment in the feature space of a frozen detector Φ \Phi that assigns anomaly scores to a feature sequence 𝐱 ∈ ℝ T × D \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times D} . To do so, for each video x x we first generate a hierarchical graph 𝒢 x \mathcal{G}_{x} composed of root nodes (agents in the video), action nodes (the actions the agents take) and outcome nodes (the outcomes of the actions taken by the agents). 𝒢 x \mathcal{G}_{x} is generated by iteratively prompting a VLM teacher (Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] ) with the video and three structured prompts (Figure S4 of the appendix).
ETU maps 𝐱 \mathbf{x} to a discrete semantic dependency graph 𝒢 ^ x \hat{\mathcal{G}}_{x} (Section 3.1 ), a prediction supervised by the teacher graph 𝒢 x \mathcal{G}_{x} . ETU then regenerates 𝐱 \mathbf{x} conditioned on 𝒢 ^ x \hat{\mathcal{G}}_{x} or on a masked variant m ⁡ ( 𝒢 ^ x ) m(\hat{\mathcal{G}}_{x}) (Section 3.2 ), and reads Φ \Phi ’s score change between the two reconstructions as the audit’s measurement.

Node Reconstruction. We map video features to human-verifiable concepts by allocating M = 25 M=25 node slots for each semantic type, roots ( A r A_{r} ), actions ( A a A_{a} ), and outcomes ( A o A_{o} ), each quantised against a codebook of N = 32 N=32 prototypes. Video features are queried via type-specific cross-attention blocks applied sequentially, yielding continuous hidden representations 𝐧 ∈ ℝ D \mathbf{n}\in\mathbb{R}^{D} . These hidden states are grounded in a discrete manifold via three disjoint codebooks [ 50 ] 𝐂 ∈ ℝ N × D \mathbf{C}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D} . We initialize and regularize each codebook to be orthonormal across the first D / 2 D/2 dimensions, ensuring that each of the N N prototypes represents a distinct semantic concept and keeping prototypes composable. A Gumbel-Softmax [ 17 ] estimator computes the categorical selection vector 𝐧 ^ ∈ ℝ N \mathbf{\hat{n}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N} over the prototypes. To shape the latent manifold for counterfactual auditing, the model minimizes a contrastive loss. As shown in Figure 2 , targeted masking of the reconstructed graph allows us to generate three counterfactual latents, 𝐳 irr \mathbf{z}_{\text{irr}} (removal of nodes that are not on the path to an outcome node), 𝐳 rel \mathbf{z}_{\text{rel}} (removal of nodes that are on the path of an outcome node), and 𝐳 sem \mathbf{z}_{\text{sem}} (substitution of nodes closest to the ground-truth atoms with randomly-sampled, factually incorrect atoms). The teacher lists ordinary and unusual events alike, so the relevant mask removes every outcome chain of a video and not only the anomalous one. The loss enforces structural invariance to noise while maximizing sensitivity to semantic interventions: ℒ cont GEM = λ irr ​ ( 1 − cos ⁡ ( 𝐳 graph , 𝐳 irr ) ) + λ sem ​ max ⁡ ( 0 , cos ⁡ ( 𝐳 graph , 𝐳 sem ) ) + λ rel ​ max ⁡ ( 0 , cos ⁡ ( 𝐳 graph , 𝐳 rel ) ) \begin{split}\mathcal{L}_{\text{cont}}^{\text{GEM}}=&\lambda_{\text{irr}}(1-\cos(\mathbf{z}_{\text{graph}},\mathbf{z}_{\text{irr}}))\\
&+\lambda_{\text{sem}}\max(0,\cos(\mathbf{z}_{\text{graph}},\mathbf{z}_{\text{sem}}))\\
&+\lambda_{\text{rel}}\max(0,\cos(\mathbf{z}_{\text{graph}},\mathbf{z}_{\text{rel}}))\end{split} (5) Finally, VICReg regularization [ 2 ] prevents embedding collapse by enforcing unit variance, minimizing off-diagonal covariance ( C ​ o ​ v Cov ), and ensuring invariance under irrelevant masking: ℒ vicreg = 1 D ​ ∑ d = 1 D max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − V ​ a ​ r ​ ( 𝐳 graph ( d ) ) ) + 1 D ∑ d ≠ d ′ [ C o v ( 𝐳 graph ) ] d , d ′ 2 + MSE ( 𝐳 graph , 𝐳 irr ) . \begin{split}\mathcal{L}_{\text{vicreg}}=&\frac{1}{D}\sum_{d=1}^{D}\max(0,1-\sqrt{Var(\mathbf{z}_{\text{graph}}^{(d)})})\\
&+\frac{1}{D}\sum_{d\neq d^{\prime}}[Cov(\mathbf{z}_{\text{graph}})]_{d,d^{\prime}}^{2}+\text{MSE}(\mathbf{z}_{\text{graph}},\mathbf{z}_{\text{irr}}).\end{split} (6) The first term of Eq. 5 and the last term of Eq. 6 pull 𝐳 irr \mathbf{z}_{\text{irr}} onto 𝐳 graph \mathbf{z}_{\text{graph}} , and on normal videos the last term of Eq. 5 pulls 𝐳 rel \mathbf{z}_{\text{rel}} onto it as well, so this loss uses the video-level label of the training videos. A near-zero Δ irr \Delta_{\text{irr}} is therefore a result of training and does not describe the detector, and ETU does not measure a dependence on background content. Section 4.2 tests the divergence objective of Eq. 5 by removing it from GEM and by adding one to the generator. Implementation details are given in Section A.2 of the appendix.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We audit seven frozen detectors [ 6 , 72 , 49 , 34 , 66 , 62 , 58 ] , but ETU can be seamlessly employed to audit any VAD-model for which it is possible to reconstruct the latent space of the training data. We carry out this audit on UCF-Crime [ 45 ] , which contains real-world CCTV footage, and XD-Violence [ 57 ] , which contains movie clips, with the two most used encoders in the field, I3D [ 4 ] and CLIP [ 36 ] . PEL4VAD is audited on I3D features only, DSANet and VadCLIP on CLIP features only. We follow the standard evaluation protocols of the two datasets [ 29 , 58 , 45 , 57 ] and report every delta as the reconstruction-referenced change of Eq. 8 , at noise level t = 300 t{=}300 unless stated otherwise. Every configuration is trained with three seeds, and we report the mean over seeds. Configurations are selected on a held-out subset of the training videos, never on the test videos. No VLM is used at test time. GEM predicts the graph of a test video from its features alone through the learned codebooks, and every mask is computed on that predicted graph. The experiments of Section 4.2 are carried out on UCF-Crime with CLIP features. Two further chains serve as ablations on the same track, namely a divergence-trained generator , the same architecture trained with an added divergence objective on its reconstructions (Section A.3.2 of the appendix), and a divergence-free ETU , in which GEM is trained without the objective of Eq. 5 .

PEL4VAD只接受I3D特性的审计,DSANet和VadCLIP只接受CLIP特性的审计. 我们遵循两个数据集的标准评价协议[29,58,45,57],并将每个三角洲报告为重建参考的Eq.8变化,除非另有说明,噪声水平 t=300 t{=}300. 每个配置都用三种种子来训练, 我们报告种子的平均值。 配置在培训视频中被搁置的子集中选择,从未在测试视频中选择. 测试时没有使用VLM. GEM通过所学的密码本来预测一个测试视频的图解,每个口罩都在这个预测的图解上计算. 第4.2节的实验是针对具有《犯罪法》特点的UCF-犯罪进行的。 另外两条链条是在同一轨道上铺设的,即经过差异训练的发电机,经过培训的建筑,其重建方面又有差异目标(附录A.3.2节),以及没有差异的ETU,其中GEM的培训没有第5项的目标。

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the audit. Its first column per track, Δ graph \Delta_{\text{graph}} , shows that regenerating the features under the complete graph costs the detectors very little. On UCF-Crime with CLIP features the drop lies between − 0.10 -0.10 and 0.30 0.30 AUC points, and across the four tracks it is below one point on 16 of the 22 track-detector cells and at most 3.25 points, for MGFN on UCF-Crime with I3D features, so the audited models keep their operating points on regenerated input, and every masked delta is read against a reconstruction that the detectors barely notice. The clean scores are reported in Table S9 of the appendix. On UCF-Crime/CLIP, substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, removing the outcome chain costs each of the six between 4.23 and 6.78 AUC points, and pruning the background nodes costs nothing beyond the regeneration. For scale, deleting the 10% of feature dimensions with the largest magnitude costs the same detectors between 3.50 and 15.37 AUC points (Table S12 of the appendix). Under the relevant mask the six detectors respond by similar amounts, the largest delta exceeding the smallest by a factor of 1.6, while the six clean scores lie within 5.78 points of one another. On the other three tracks as well, substituting the scene semantics or removing the outcome chain costs far more than pruning the background nodes, which costs nothing beyond the regeneration on CLIP and at most 3.54 AP points on I3D. VLM explainers such as Holmes-VAU [ 67 ] are not in Table 1 because their scores do not read the feature space that the audit intervenes on, and counterfactual prompting does not replace the audit, since their score stays nearly unchanged under a counterfactual prompt whether the explanation changes or not (Figure 1 ; Section B of the appendix).

blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 三角洲措施

blocks.en: In this section, we analyze what the delta of Eq. 8 responds to. A change of score under a masked reconstruction admits explanations other than the semantics that were removed, namely the cost of regenerating the features, the size of the perturbation, and the training of the generator itself. We test each of them on UCF-Crime with CLIP features, the perturbation size and the displacement for the relevant mask only, and we then ablate the divergence objective in the generator and in GEM to identify what makes the intervention targeted.

blocks.en: Divergence objective in GFD. To see what changes when the generator is trained to produce the contrast that the audit measures, we train the same architecture with the divergence objective of Eq. S1 of the appendix on the same GEM latent, which keeps the irrelevant-mask reconstruction on the full-graph one and pushes the relevant- and semantic-mask reconstructions at least a margin away from it. As shown in Table 3 , this divergence-trained generator fails the test that ETU passes. The difference between the relevant mask and the random deletion is positive for 1 of the six detectors, indistinguishable from zero for 3 and negative for 2. Table S11 of the appendix shows why. One random node that it has not seen in training costs it between 1.75 and 14.92 points, on average 9.91 points against 15.18 for the whole relevant mask, and once a random-node variant is added to its training one random node changes the AUC by at most 0.09 points (Table S10 ). Its relevant-mask reconstruction of the anomalous videos is nearly orthogonal to its full-graph reconstruction (median cosine 0.051), while the random draw moves farther still ( − 0.217 -0.217 ; Table S17 ), and for four of the six detectors the random draw also costs more. A generator trained to separate the interventions thus reacts to any conditioning it was not trained on, and its deltas cannot be attributed to the content that the mask removes; without such an objective, a change in the scores of the audited detectors can only come from the change in the conditioning that GFD receives.

blocks.en: Divergence objective in GEM. ETU still relies on a graph embedding trained with the divergence objective of Eq. 5 . To verify that this objective is what makes the intervention effective, we retrain GEM without it and train a new reconstruction-only generator on its latent. As shown in Table 3 , removing the outcome chain and removing the same number of random nodes then have the same effect on all six detectors, and both effects are small, although the new GEM reconstructs the graphs as accurately as the original one.
blocks.zh: GEM中的分歧目标. ETU仍然依靠一个以Eq. 5的分化目标训练出来的图。 为了证实这个目标是有效干预的目的,我们重新培训没有这种技术的GEM,并在它的潜在作用上培训一个新的只用于重建的发电机。 如表3所示,去除结果链和去除同样数量的随机节点,然后对所有六个探测器产生同样的效果,两种效果都很小,虽然新的GEM像原来的一样精确地重建了图表.

blocks.en: Table 3 therefore shows three regimes of the same intervention. With the divergence objective in GEM only, removing the outcome chain moves every detector while a random deletion of the same size moves none, although it displaces the features about as much. With the objective in the generator as well, a random deletion pushes the reconstructed features off the manifold, and the detectors react to the displacement instead of the content that was removed. Without the objective, neither deletion moves the detectors. We conclude that the divergence objective in GEM is the design choice that turns a masked graph into a targeted intervention on the input features, whose effect depends on which nodes are masked and not on the size of the perturbation.
blocks.zh: 因此,表3显示了三种相同的干预制度。 仅使用GEM中的差分目标,去除结果链会移动每个探测器,而随机删除相同大小的探测器则不会移动,尽管它会使特性相去甚远. 以生成器中的目标,随机删除将重建的特性推离复数,探测器对移位的反应而不是被移位的内容. 如果没有目标,则不删除会移动探测器. 我们的结论是,GEM中的分歧目标是设计选择,将蒙面图变成对输入特征的定向干预,其效果取决于节点被遮掩,而不是扰动大小.

blocks.en: Detector-specific readings. The audit can also separate detectors whose benchmark scores are close. DSANet and UR-DMU reach clean AUCs of 89.44 and 85.05 on UCF-Crime with CLIP features (Table S9 of the appendix), yet substituting the scene semantics costs DSANet more than UR-DMU (Table 1 ). Figure 3 shows how differently the two detectors respond to the relevant mask on one video. The score of DSANet drops on every segment, whereas UR-DMU is saturated when unmasked and responds all-or-nothing. At the dataset level, masking a single node changes the frame-AUC by at most 0.28 points when the node lies on the outcome chain and 1.80 points when it lies off it, against 4.23 to 6.78 points for the whole chain (Table S21 of the appendix). A single-node mask also removes every node that depends on it downstream.

blocks.en: 4.3 Dependence on the Teacher

blocks.en: To assess how much the graphs depend on the VLM that produces them, we parsed the UCF-Crime videos with three teachers, Qwen3-VL (the teacher of all other experiments), InternVideo3 and Gemma-4, using the same prompts, and compared their graphs video by video (Section D and Table S20 of the appendix). The atoms of two teachers on the same video agree more than those of two videos of the same anomaly class on 73.4–81.4% of the videos, whereas the edges agree little, with an edge F 1 F_{1} of 0.138–0.250 for two teachers on the same video against 0.111–0.167 for two videos of the same class. The outcome chain is therefore a property of the teacher’s parse, as GEM reproduces it, and not a structure of the scene that any teacher would recover. The parsed graphs do not fill the slots. The mean graph has 3.74 roots, 4.71 actions and 3.80 outcomes against M = 25 M{=}25 slots per type, while all N = 32 N{=}32 prototypes of each type are in use (Table S1 of the appendix).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Explain The Unexplainable (ETU), a framework that audits frozen Video Anomaly Detection models by regenerating their input features under a masked semantic dependency graph and reading the change in their score, with one set of interventions handed unchanged to every detector. On UCF-Crime/CLIP, substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and removing the outcome chain costs every detector more than a count-matched random deletion that moves the reconstruction about as far; the intervention becomes indistinguishable from a random one without the divergence objective of the graph embedding, and a response to the displacement of the reconstruction with a divergence objective in the generator. ETU therefore measures how much a detector’s score depends on the graph-conditioned content of its input features. Its generator must stay out of the objective that makes the intervention targeted.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了“解释无法解释的(ETU)”这个框架,通过在隐形语义依赖图下重现其输入特征,并读取其分数的变化,对被冻结的视频异常检测模型进行审计,其中一套干预措施没有给每个检测器。 在UCF-Crime/CLIP上,替换场景语义对大多数探测器造成最大下降,并去除结果链成本超过一个计数随机删除,将重建移动到最远;干预变得无法与没有图嵌入的分化目标的随机分化区分,并用生成器中的分化目标应对重建的转移. 因此,ETU测量一个探测器的分数取决于其输入特性的图形化内容。 它的产生者必须远离使干预成为目标的目标。

blocks.en:
ETU expands the scope of Explainable VAD by shifting the objective from description to intervention. By learning a discrete semantic prior and utilizing guided diffusion to systematically ablate semantic concepts in the latent space, ETU allows to evaluate a pre-trained VAD model via counterfactual interventions.
We define the VAD task as assigning anomaly scores S ∈ ℝ T × 1 S\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times 1} to a feature sequence 𝐱 ∈ ℝ T × D \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times D} , obtained through a pre-trained video encoder, using a VAD model Φ \Phi . To explain the decision logic of Φ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \Phi(\mathbf{x}) , we seek a counterfactual feature reconstruction 𝐱 ^ m \mathbf{\hat{x}}_{m} that represents a minimal, semantically-guided intervention m m on the original scene.

blocks.en: A.2.1 Node Reconstruction

blocks.en: Given I3D video features 𝐱 ∈ ℝ T × 1024 \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times 1024} , GEM learns to reconstruct the three hierarchical levels of a semantic dependency graph, namely root nodes (actors/objects), Action nodes (actions/states), and Outcome nodes (consequences/anomalies). We utilize a discrete codebook of learned prototypes via Gumbel-Softmax selection. We ablate the codebook capacity and regularization.

blocks.en: Given the reconstructed nodes, GEM must predict dependency edges to form a meaningful topology. Due to the extreme class imbalance (valid edges account for approximately 0.7% of the 1250 candidate pairs in a reconstructed graph that contains 25 root, 25 action and 25 outcome node slots), robust architectural and optimization choices are required.

This stems from the higher variance in Outcome node embeddings (consequences and anomalies). We corrected this by applying an asymmetric loss weight ( λ = 5.0 \lambda=5.0 for ℒ A ​ O \mathcal{L}_{AO} ) to false negatives on the AO level, raising the AO F 0.5 F_{0.5} from 0.653 to 0.768.

blocks.en: A.2.5 Joint Training Dynamics
blocks.zh: A.2.5 联合培训动态

blocks.en: A challenge in end-to-end training is the destructive interference between node reconstruction and edge prediction. Ground-truth nodes exhibit a 3% to 6% cosine separation between connected pairs. However, after passing through the reconstruction bottleneck, this separation drops to 0.02% (a 275 × \times reduction), causing modular GEM training to fail entirely ( F 0.5 ≈ 0.01 F_{0.5}\approx 0.01 ).
blocks.zh: 端到端训练的一个挑战是节点重建与边缘预测之间的破坏性干扰. 地面真实节点显示连接对之间有3%至6%的余弦分离. 然而,经过重建瓶颈后,这种分离下降到0.02%(a 275x\\时间的减少),导致模块化的GEM训练完全失败(F 0.5 + 0.01 F + 0.5+ 约0.01)。

blocks.en: We solved this via joint end-to-end training, which forces the reconstruction objective to preserve edge-relevant features. To prevent gradient conflicts in shared layers, we implemented dual refinement pathways (separating the edge refinement gradient from the reconstruction gradient), successfully restoring edge prediction capabilities on reconstructed nodes. Detaching the gradients completely (stop-grad) resulted in edge failure ( F 0.5 = 0.323 F_{0.5}=0.323 ), confirming that gradients must flow through the shared backbone.
blocks.zh: 我们通过联合端对端培训解决了这一问题,这迫使重建目标保持边缘相关特征。 为了防止共享层的梯度冲突,我们实施了双精细路径(将边缘精细梯度与重建梯度分开),成功恢复重建节点的边缘预测能力. 完全去除梯度(stop-grad)导致边缘故障(F 0.5 = 0.323 F_{0.5}=0.323),确认梯度必须流经共享骨干.

blocks.en: A.2.6 Graph Embeddings
blocks.zh: A.2.6 图内嵌

blocks.en: The goal of GEM is to yield a single embedding z graph ∈ ℝ 512 z_{\text{graph}}\in\mathbb{R}^{512} that accurately dictates the behavior of the downstream diffusion model. This embedding must be both highly discriminative and counterfactually sensitive.
blocks.zh: GEM的目标是产生一个单一嵌入式z图 QQ R 512 z_{\text{graph\in\mathbb{R}^{512},精确地支配下游扩散模型的行为. 这种嵌入必须具有高度的歧视性和反事实敏感性。

blocks.en: A.2.7 Graph Topology Injection
blocks.zh: A.2.7 图地形注射

blocks.en: To aggregate the predicted graph structure into a single vector, we evaluated various pooling and message-passing schemes (Table S4 ). While standard Graph Isomorphism Networks (GIN) [ 59 ] are popular, the message passing corrupted our specific edge-relevant features, degrading edge F 0.5 F_{0.5} to 0.322. Edge-Gated Pooling , where node representations are weighted by their predicted edge connectivity before mean pooling, safely injected topology into the latent space while maintaining high linear probe performance.
blocks.zh: 为了将预测的图表结构合并为一个单一的矢量,我们评价了各种集合和传递信息方案(表S4)。 虽然标准图Isomorphism Networks(GIN)[59]很受欢迎,但传递的信息腐蚀了我们特定的边缘相关特征,贬低了边缘F 0.5 F_{0.5}到0.322. Edge-Gated Pooling(边-Gated Pooling),其中节点的表示值被其预测的边缘连通性加权,然后才表示集成,安全地将地形注入潜在空间,同时保持高线性探测性能.

blocks.zh: 表S4:将边缘地形注入图表嵌入的方法。

blocks.en: A.2.8 Latent Regularization and Counterfactual Training
blocks.zh: A.2.8 初级正规化和反事实培训

blocks.en: To prevent embedding collapse and ensure the latent space reacts correctly to counterfactual manipulations, we use Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization (VICReg) [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了防止嵌入坍塌并确保潜在空间对反事实操纵的正确反应,我们使用差异-Invariance-Covariance正规化(VICReg)[2].

blocks.en: As shown in Table S5 , applying VICReg with a weight of λ = 1.0 \lambda=1.0 monotonically improves the Linear Probe AUC (LP AUC, measuring linear separability of normal vs. anomalous graphs) and increases the Counterfactual (CF) Gap. The CF gap measures the difference in cosine similarity when the model masks out relevant anomaly nodes versus irrelevant background nodes. A larger gap implies the downstream diffusion model will react more strongly to the removal of anomaly-relevant nodes.
blocks.zh: 如表S5所示,采用VICReg,重量为QQ=1.0\lambda=1.0单调改进了线性探测AUC(LP AUC,测量正常对异常图的线性分离性),增加了反事实(CF)差距. CF差距测量模型遮盖出相关异常节点相对于不相关的背景节点时,余弦相似性的差异. 更大的差距意味着下游扩散模型将对消除异常相关节点作出更强烈的反应。

blocks.en: A.2.9 Curriculum Learning and Phase Transitions
blocks.zh: A.2.9 课程学习和阶段过渡

blocks.en: We observed that the model requires a strict curriculum to converge. The most important finding was the necessity of full-phase contrastive training (Table S6 ). Extending training beyond the joint edge-reconstruction phase to explicitly train the contrastive masking objectives (steps 45K to 60K) yielded improvements in the CF gap (67%) and general embedding separation, with only a negligible (2% to 3%) cost to the structural edge F 0.5 F_{0.5} score.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,这一模式需要严格的课程统一。 最重要的结论是必须进行全阶段的对比性培训(表S6)。 将培训范围扩大到联合边缘重建阶段之外,以明确培训对比性遮掩目标(第45K至60K步),结果提高了CF差距(67%)和一般嵌入分离,结构边缘F0.5 F_{0.5}得分只有可忽略不计的(2%至3%)成本。

blocks.zh: A.2.10 最后选定配置和分析

blocks.en: Based on the explorations detailed above, the selected architecture leverages 32 discrete prototypes, Edge-Gated pooling, VICReg, and asymmetric AO loss weighting, trained through the full 60K step contrastive curriculum.
blocks.zh: 基于上面详述的探索,所选建筑利用32个离散原型,边格-Gated集合,VICReg,以及不对称的AO减重,通过完整的60K步对比课程来训练.

blocks.en: As shown in Table S7 , the chosen configuration reaches a Counterfactual Gap of 1.067. When the predicted outcome-chain nodes are masked out (Relevant masking) the embedding cosine similarity drops to − - 0.123, while removing off-chain background nodes leaves the embedding nearly untouched (0.944). This is the behaviour the downstream Graph-Conditioned Feature Diffusion (GFD) model requires of its conditioning; it is a property of the trained embedding, selected for by this very criterion, and not evidence about any audited detector.
blocks.zh: 如表S7所示,所选配置达到反事实差距1.067. 当预测的结果链节点被遮蔽(相关遮蔽)时,嵌入的余弦相似度下降至− - 0.123,而去掉脱链背景节点则使嵌入的余弦几乎不受影响(0.944)。 这就是下游的Graph-Contitiond Feature Difusion(GFD)模型要求其调制的行为;它是训练有素的嵌入物的属性,根据这个标准来选择,而不是任何经过审计的探测器的证据.

blocks.en: Topological Complexity and Alignment. High node reconstruction faithfulness ( > 0.85 >0.85 ) is consistently achieved, though alignment varies by dataset. UCF-Crime exhibits higher alignment due to the spatio-temporal stability of fixed-camera CCTV footage. Conversely, the movie-based clips in XD-Violence contain frequent temporal discontinuities and high visual variance, resulting in complex ground-truth graphs with higher node density in anomalous segments.
blocks.zh: 地形复杂与对齐. 高节点重建的忠诚度( > 0.85 > 0.85)是一贯的,尽管因数据集而异。 UCF-Crime显示,由于固定相机闭路电视镜头的时空稳定性,对齐率更高。 反之,XD-暴力中的电影片段包含频繁的时断时续和高度的视差,导致复杂的地面真象图,反常段节点密度较高.

blocks.en: Edge Prediction and Metric Selection. We prioritize precision via the F 0.5 F_{0.5} metric to heavily penalize false-positive edges, as spurious connections would compromise the integrity of the counterfactual audit. GEM achieves F 0.5 ≥ 0.64 F_{0.5}\geq 0.64 across all settings. Given the significant class imbalance between candidate and actual edges, this performance demonstrates a robust ability to filter environmental noise while preserving the essential outcome-chain backbone.

blocks.en: Embedding Separation. Graph embedding similarities show that the conditioning layer separates the relevant and semantic variants from the full graph. Irrelevant maskings ( 𝐳 irr \mathbf{z}_{\text{irr}} ) remain near-identical to the full graph ( 𝐳 graph \mathbf{z}_{\text{graph}} ), while the relevant ( 𝐳 rel \mathbf{z}_{\text{rel}} ) and semantic ( 𝐳 sem \mathbf{z}_{\text{sem}} ) variants diverge, the semantic one to negative cosine similarity, most markedly on XD-Violence. This is the separation that the contrastive objective of Section 3.1 of the main paper trains for. Whether the score of a frozen detector depends on what was removed is established by the experiments of Sections 4.1 and 4.2 of the main paper.

blocks.en: The denoiser employs a Transformer-based architecture formulated for noise prediction ( ϵ \epsilon prediction). At each diffusion timestep t t , the network receives noisy video features 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} and a graph conditioning embedding 𝐳 \mathbf{z} , predicting the added noise ϵ \epsilon .
blocks.zh: Denoiser采用了为噪声预测(QQ\epsilon 预测)而设计的基于变形器的架构. 在每次扩散时间步 t t 时, 网络都会收到吵闹的视频功能 x t\ mathbf{x}_{t} 和一个嵌入 z\ mathbf{z} 的图形条件, 预测新增的噪音 \\\\ epsilon 。

blocks.en: Graph conditioning is injected via two complementary pathways. First, Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) [ 33 ] utilizes a linear projection to map 𝐳 ∈ ℝ 512 \mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{512} to scale and shift parameters applied following each layer normalization. Second, a cross-attention mechanism projects 𝐳 \mathbf{z} to learned conditioning tokens that function as keys and values. To accommodate varying feature extractors, a linear input projection compresses I3D features ( d feat = 1024 d_{\text{feat}}=1024 ) to the model dimension ( d model = 512 d_{\text{model}}=512 ) prior to processing, whereas CLIP features ( d feat = 512 d_{\text{feat}}=512 ) natively match the internal dimension.
blocks.zh: 图形调节通过两个互补途径注入. 首先,Feature-wise Linear Modulating (FiLM) [33] 使用线性投影来映射 z → R 512 \ mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{512} 来缩放和移位参数在每层正常化后应用. 第二,一个交叉注意机制项目 z\ mathbf{z} 用于学习的调值符, 其功能是键和值 。 为适应不同特性提取器,线性输入投影将I3D特性(d feat = 1024 d_{\text{ feat}}=1024)压缩到处理前的模型维度(d model = 512 d_{\text{model}}=512),而CLIP特性(d feat = 512 d_{\text{ feat}}=512)则在本土上与内部维度匹配.

For each video we pose the default prompt and a counterfactual prompt that asks which anomalies would occur without a named element of the scene, and plot the per-snippet anomaly scores under the two prompts.

blocks.en: In the “earthquake” video (Figure S2 ), the explanation under the default prompt names “a sudden and unexpected occurrence of a car accident” as the anomaly; under the counterfactual prompt (no earthquake) it describes a normal street scene with no unusual events. Both score curves stay below 0.2 on every snippet, so the default explanation reports an anomaly that the score does not register. In the “superwind” video (Figure S3 ), the counterfactual prompt asks which anomalies would occur without the wind; the explanation names the same anomaly as under the default prompt, a tornado, “[…] often accompanied by strong winds […]”, so it ignores the counterfactual premise, and the two score curves are again nearly identical. blocks.en: Every confidence interval that this paper reports for the count-matched random deletion comes from one procedure. The resampling unit is the video, and each replicate is one draw with replacement of the UCF-Crime test videos of Table 3 of the main paper, applied in lockstep to the full-graph, relevant-mask and random-deletion conditionings and to all six detectors, so that every quantity compared here is paired on the same videos. We draw B = 10,000 B=10{,}000 replicates, recompute the benchmark metric inside each replicate (frame AUC over the pooled frames of the replicate, not an average of per-video values), and report the two-sided percentile interval between the 2.5th and the 97.5th percentiles of the replicate distribution. The intervals resample videos only. The difference Δ rel − Δ rand \Delta_{\text{rel}}-\Delta_{\text{rand}} is in frame-AUC points. The ratio | Δ rand | / Δ rel |\Delta_{\text{rand}}|/\Delta_{\text{rel}} is dimensionless and undefined on a replicate whose Δ rel \Delta_{\text{rel}} is not positive, so those replicates are dropped from the interval of the ratio only (at most 13 of 10,000 10{,}000 for any detector at t = 300 t{=}300 ).

Tables S17 and S18 report the displacement behind the intervals of Table S16 , at the level of the reconstruction and of the conditioning latent. On ETU the count-matched random draw displaces the reconstruction at least as far as the relevant mask on the normal videos and about as far on the anomalous ones, while on the divergence-trained generator the relevant-mask reconstruction of the anomalous videos is nearly orthogonal to the full-graph one (median cosine 0.051) and the random draw moves farther still ( − 0.217 -0.217 ). The asymmetry between the relevant and the random deletion on ETU is therefore not inherited from the geometry that the contrastive objective of Eq. 5 trains. This holds for the cosine only. blocks.en: In Figure 6(a) , masking the root node Woman lowers the per-video AP by 0.042 against the ground-truth features (0.970 to 0.928) and by 0.012 against the full-graph reconstruction (0.940), and masking the action node Driving behaves alike (0.933); masking the outcome node Leaving lowers it by 0.171 (to 0.799) and pushes every score below 0.1 0.1 , a larger change than the whole relevant mask on this video (0.894). blocks.en: Figure S7 : MIL anomaly-score traces for a Braveheart scene. The annotated window covers most of the clip, so the single-node masks lower the scores while leaving the per-video AP within 0.004 of the ground-truth features (legend).
blocks.zh: 图S7:一个勇敢的场景的MIL异常积分痕迹. 附加说明的窗口覆盖了大部分的片段,因此单节口罩降低分数,同时让每集视频AP在地面真实功能(legend)的0.04范围内.

blocks.en: Figure S7 is a near-saturated case, in which the ground-truth features score 0.989 AP, the full-graph reconstruction 0.990, and every single-node mask lands within 0.004 of them ( Woman 0.986, Walking 0.987, Sustaining 0.987) although the masked traces are visibly lower across the video; semantic masking lowers the AP to 0.976 while driving all scores below 0.5 0.5 , and the relevant mask raises it to 0.994. When the anomalous window covers most of the clip, as here, a mask can lower every score and leave the ranking, and hence the AP, almost unchanged. This is why the main paper reports test-set deltas and tests their alternative explanations, rather than per-video curves.
blocks.zh: 图S7是一个近乎饱和的病例,其中地面真人特征得分0.989 AP,全图重建0.990,每个单节口罩在其中0.04以内着陆(Woman 0.986,Walking 0.987,Keeping 0.987),尽管整个视频的蒙面痕迹明显较低;语义性面具将AP降低到0.976,同时驾驶所有分数低于0.5 0.5,相关面具将其提升到0.994. 当反常的窗口覆盖大部分的片段时,像这里一样,一个面具可以降低每个分数并离开排名,因此AP几乎不变. 正因为如此,主要论文报告了测试-设定三角洲,并测试了它们的替代解释,而不是每个视频曲线.

blocks.en: Figure S8 : MIL anomaly-score traces for two Brick Mansions scenes. Masking the root node Man leaves the first scene’s AP within 0.01 of the ground-truth features and lowers the second scene’s from 0.600 to 0.399 (legends).
blocks.zh: 图S8:MIL异常-积分的痕迹,用于两个Brick Mansion场景. 遮掩根节点人会在0.01个地面真实特征范围内留下第一幕的AP,并将第二幕从0.

blocks.en: Figures 8(a) and 8(b) show the three masked nodes on two scenes of one film with very different outcomes. In the first scene masking the root node Man changes the AP by less than 0.01 (0.865 against 0.856 for the ground-truth features and 0.872 for 𝐳 𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐩𝐡 \mathbf{z_{graph}} ), masking the outcome node Leaving by 0.01 (0.883), while masking the action node Firing lowers it to 0.740 and suppresses the scores of the normal segment (frames 630 to 900) and of the final anomalous segment while raising those between frames 200 and 600. In the second scene masking Man lowers the AP from 0.600 to 0.399 and flattens the trace, Driving gives 0.457 and Leaving 0.560, and the relevant mask raises the AP to 0.622 while the full-graph reconstruction sits at 0.537. The response to a node name is therefore video-specific, and on single videos it is not monotone in what the mask removes, and the controlled, aggregate deltas of the main paper are the quantity on which the paper rests.
blocks.zh: 图8(a)和图8(b)在一部电影的两个场景上显示三个蒙面节点,结果非常不同。 在第一幕中遮掩根节点人会将AP修改小于0.01(地面真实特性0.865对0.856,z图\mathbf{z_{graph}}}0.872),遮掩结果节点离开0.01(0.883),同时遮掩动作节点Firing将其降低到0.740,压制正常段(帧630至900)和最终异常段的得分,同时提升帧200至600之间的得分. 第二幕"蒙面人"将AP从0.600降低到0.399,并平整了追踪,驾驶给予0.457和leave 0.560,相关面具将AP提升到0.622,而全图重建则坐落在0.537. 因此,对节点名称的响应是视频特异性的,在单个视频中,它不是面具去掉的单酮,而主纸的受控,聚合的三角形是纸张所依赖的数量.
